# No Commit Flag — verify --no-commit flag skips git commits

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: No Commit Note
summary: Test no-commit flag
tags: test
---
No-commit content.
-- note-input.md --

-- append-input.md --
Appended without commit.
-- append-input.md --

-- commit-note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Commit Note
summary: Test commit
tags: test
---
Commit content.
-- commit-note-input.md --

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# Record initial commit count (should be 1 from init)
exec git log --oneline
cp stdout initial-commits.txt

# --- Write with --no-commit should NOT create a git commit ---
exec akb --no-commit write nocommit-note.md <../note-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/nocommit-note.md'

# Verify file exists on disk (write still happened)
exists kb/notes/nocommit-note.md

# Verify no new commit was created
exec git log --oneline
cmp stdout initial-commits.txt

# --- Delete with --no-commit should NOT create a git commit ---
exec akb --no-commit delete notes/nocommit-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/nocommit-note.md'

# Verify file is gone from disk (delete still happened)
! exists kb/notes/nocommit-note.md

# Verify still no new commit
exec git log --oneline
cmp stdout initial-commits.txt

# --- Write without --no-commit DOES create a commit ---
exec akb write commit-note.md <../commit-note-input.md

# Verify a new commit was created
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: write kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Append with --no-commit should NOT create a git commit ---
# First, record current commit count
exec git log --oneline
cp stdout before-append-commits.txt

exec akb --no-commit append notes/commit-note.md <../append-input.md
stdout 'Appended to kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# Verify content was appended
exec akb read notes/commit-note.md
stdout 'Appended without commit.'

# Verify no new commit
exec git log --oneline
cmp stdout before-append-commits.txt
